summary.en: The handset look: a head-on code-drawn device on a near-black or porcelain ground, one accent for the region in play, Inter Tight in the margin, IBM Plex Mono for notes and the source line.
summary.zh: handset 的样式：近黑或瓷白底上一台正面、代码画的设备，一个只标当前区域的强调色，页边用 Inter Tight，注释与来源行用 IBM Plex Mono。

fits: Launches whose claim can be seen on the product’s own screen: real captures of pages, pickers, docs, official charts.
notFor: Products with no screen; stories of many artefacts side by side; anything that needs a drawn UI.

intent.en: A quiet, locked-off frame where the only colour is the product’s own screen and one mark pointing at it.
intent.zh: 安静、固定的画面：唯一的颜色是产品自己的屏幕，加一个指向它的标记。

content.en: Real captures of the product (2× or 3×); short margin copy (a value ≤ 10 chars, lines ≤ 18 chars).
content.zh: 产品的真实截图（2 倍或 3 倍像素）；页边短文案（数值 ≤ 10 字符，一行 ≤ 18 字符 / 14 字）。

fits.zh: 能在产品自己的屏幕上看到主张的发布：真实的页面、选择器、文档、官方图表截图。

notFor.zh: 没有屏幕的产品；多件物料并排对照的故事；需要画出来的界面。

en: Take another preset when the accent sits within ΔE00 20 of a colour filling the ringed region.
Never draw a UI on the screen; only captures go there.
zh: 强调色与被圈区域里的主色 ΔE00 不足 20 时换一套配色。
屏幕上不画界面，只放截图。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
